workPackages.subject: Phase 1 Refinement: CMS Tri-Platform & Auth-Gating
workPackages.description: Ekspansi Phase 1 untuk Web Sekota: Implementasi CMS Pengelola (Desktop, Android, CLI) dan Inline Auth-Gating Modal Dialog.

workPackages.subject: UC-GATE-01: Implement Inline Auth Modal Dialog in Web Sekota
workPackages.description: Mengimplementasikan AuthGateDialog pada BookDetailsScreen dan MerchandiseScreen untuk memvalidasi login sebelum Read/Download atau Order.

workPackages.subject: UC-CMS-01: Implement Shared Domain & Repository for Admin Books & Tools
workPackages.description: Menyambungkan shared KMP ke endpoint /admin/books dan /admin/tools dari Swagger sekota.id dengan pure Kotlin domain UseCases & Unit Tests.

workPackages.subject: UC-CMS-02: Implement Kotlin Admin CLI (sekota-cli)
workPackages.description: Menyediakan command line interface berbasis Kotlin untuk administrasi katalog buku (list, add, delete), produk, dan merchandise.

workPackages.subject: UC-CMS-03: Implement Compose Desktop JVM & Android Admin Window
workPackages.description: Membangun antarmuka visual admin di Compose Desktop & Android untuk memantau Intelligence Suite, Books, dan Merchandise.

workPackages.subject: UC-CMS-04: Implement Products & Merchandise Management Integration
workPackages.description: Integrasi CRUD produk Intelligence Suite (Veridia, Ascendio, Sociara, Ecoflow) dan Merchandise store.
